Job Title: Sales Administrator
Company: Smiling Gecko Cambodia

Apply Now
Workplace Circumstances
Environment:
Office
Languages:
English, Khmer
Location:
Kampong Chhnang Province
Position Circumstances
Career Category:
Sales / Marketing, Business Administration
Schedule:  Full-time
Salary:
N/A
Position Summary 		  REPORT TO: Clusters Sales   and  Marketing Manager
FUNCTION: Sales / Marketing,   Business  Administration
LOCATION: Kampong Chhnang Province
SALARY: Competitive
Duties & Responsibilities:
• Sales Coordination & Order Management
• Receive   and  process customer orders accurately   and  in   a  timely manner
• Coordinate   with  production teams (Aquaculture, Chicken, Horticulture, Butchery, Bakery   and  Manufacturing)   on  order availability   and  delivery timelines
• Follow up   on  order status   and  ensure on-time delivery
• Update   and  maintain   the  order tracking system
• Customer Support
• Act   as  the first point   of  contact   for  customer inquiries   related  to orders, delivery,   and  product availability
• Support   the  sales team   in  maintaining strong client relationships
• Handle   basic  complaints   and  escalate issues when necessary
• Payment update   and  collection.
• Payment Follow-up & Coordination
• Track customer payments   and  maintain updated payment records
• Follow up   with  customers   on  pending   and  overdue payments
• Coordinate   with  the Finance team   to  confirm payment receipts   and  resolve discrepancies
• Support   collection  processes   to  ensure timely cash flow
• Internal Communication
• Bridge communication between Sales   and  Production teams   to  avoid delays   or  misalignment
• Ensure   all  departments   are  aligned   on  order quantity, specifications,   and  deadlines
• Support coordination   for  urgent   or  last-minute orders
• Sales Reporting &   Data  Management
• Prepare daily, weekly,   and  monthly sales reports
• Track sales   performance  by   product  category   and  client
• Maintain accurate customer database   and  sales records
• Support forecasting by providing   data  insights
• Documentation & Administration
• Prepare quotations, invoices, delivery notes,   and  contracts
• Ensure   all  sales documents   are  properly filed   and  updated
• Assist   in  contract   and  pricing documentation
• Support Sales & Marketing Activities
• Assist   in  preparing sales presentations   and  proposals
• Support promotional   activities  and campaigns
• Coordinate logistics   for  client meetings   or  events
Benefits:
• Free accommodation
• 3 meals per day
• Seniority payment
• Health insurance
• Other attractive benefits
Expected Profile of Candidates
Languages:
• Khmer  - Good
• English  - Good
Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree   in  Business Administration, Marketing,   or  related field
Work History:
• Sales support, admin,   or  coordination role for  1   to  2 years  as a minimum
• Marketing, preferably   in  FMCG, retail,   or  food products (fresh graduates   are  encouraged   to  apply). for  1   to  3 years
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
• Experience   in  FMCG, agriculture,   or  food production   is  an advantage
• Strong organizational   and  multitasking skills
• Proficient   in  Microsoft   Office  (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Good communication   skills  in Khmer   and  English.
• Proficiency   in  Microsoft Office; Canva/Photoshop   skills  are   a  plus.
• Strong content creation   and  social media management skills.
• Knowledge   of  Phnom Penh’s retail   is  an advantage.
• Ability   to  travel   as  required.
Soft Skills
• Good communication   and  coordination ability
• Attention   to  detail   and  accuracy
• Ability   to  work under pressure   and  handle multiple projects
